title: Explicit AC1024 default MATERIAL graph transport

source.independentSourceHeader: LibreDWG 0.14 decoded DICTIONARY_MATERIAL as hard pointer 0xE to the source material dictionary and CMATERIAL as hard pointer 0x20 to ByLayer. The HEADER links are additionally observed in /private/tmp/r18-source-2010.json. Class ordinal is file-local.
source.independentGraph: NOD ACAD_MATERIAL soft-owner entry -> material dictionary; dictionary soft-owner entries -> ByBlock, ByLayer, Global; material owner and reactor -> dictionary; default LAYER 0 hard-pointer -> Global; HEADER CMATERIAL hard-pointer -> ByLayer.

implementation.selection: Separate DRW_DwgDefaultMaterialProvider opt-in, AC1024 only. The provider receives the four planned identities when asked to affirm that other opaque caller payloads contain no hidden references or ownership claims to those identities. Rejection aborts output; raw DWG object and section replay are refused while active. The attestation is a caller responsibility, not proof of whole-document closure.
implementation.admission: After caller class callbacks and before CLASSES/HEADER emission, reject any prior case-insensitive ACAD_MATERIAL root, any existing MATERIAL class, registered raw conflicts or retained raw section. Reserve four distinct handle identities, register three source-profile MATERIAL instances with remapped class ordinal and observed proxy metadata, then register the NOD entry. Failed admission restores allocator, pending entries and class state.
implementation.emission: A compound checkpoint covers the material dictionary and all three source-profile MATERIAL frames; extension dictionary flags, source payload, exact owner/reactor references and class counts are encoded. Only synthesized layer 0 receives the Global pointer. Supplied layers remain unchanged. HEADER dictionary and current material use witnessed hard-pointer roles; absent caller CMATERIAL defaults to generated ByLayer. An explicit CMATERIAL is accepted only if it names one of the three planned material handles, otherwise output is refused without replacing the destination.
implementation.conflicts: Reject later ACAD_MATERIAL root registration and NOD/GROUP aliases to each generated identity; reject dictionary identity, owner, child and default-entry collisions; refuse caller MATERIAL records. The AC1024 frame writer checks serialized typed-handle occurrences against the reserved graph, resolves relative forms +1, -1, +offset, -offset and self, and fails closed on unknown relative roles. Only the expected NOD soft-owner edge and layer-0 Global hard pointer are exempt. A sticky conflict survives object rollback so ignored failures cannot publish.
implementation.compatibility: No change to established DRW_Interface or DRW_Header layouts/vtables, existing HEADER encoder signature, or non-opt-in writer defaults. The optional provider is a separate interface. Existing caller material graphs remain available on the non-opt-in path.

validation.fastTests: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_default_material_optin_tests libdxfrw_dwg_default_plotstyle_optin_tests libdxfrw_dwg_ac1024_default_material_tests -j4; ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R '^libdxfrw_dwg_default_material_optin$|^libdxfrw_dwg_default_plotstyle_optin$|^libdxfrw_dwg_ac1024_default_material$' --output-on-failure. PASS 3/3; subsequent material/plotstyle rerun after HEADER changes PASS 2/2.
validation.coverage: All three source values, graph owners/reactors, no-opt-in output, source root without opt-in, existing root/class/raw-section refusal, exact late-root and four-identity aliases, dictionary owner/child/identity, XRECORD owner, late entity identity, unsupported version, generated layer and supplied-layer override, pre-existing destination preservation, same-facade retries, same-writer admission allocator restoration, injected post-dictionary exception rollback, checkpoint allocation exceptions, relative handle and unknown-role guards, and six-version direct HEADER role controls. A caller-selected Global CMATERIAL is separately checked.
validation.independentReadback: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 via tests/dwg_default_material_libredwg.py. The default output verifies both HEADER pointers, NOD/dictionary owner roles, 3 MATERIAL entries and source fields (including all six identity texture matrices), LAYER to Global, proxy flags 0x481 and class instance count 3. A second generated output independently verifies caller-selected HEADER CMATERIAL Global.
validation.oda: Historical pre-VPORT-correction result: ODA File Converter 27.1.0 invoked as ODAFileConverter <input-dir> <output-dir> ACAD2013 DXF 0 0 '*.dwg' on the default-output SHA above exited 0 but produced no DXF. It reported multiple dictionary, table and BLOCK warnings, a LAYER warning, LTYPE warnings and finally AcDbViewportTableRecord 0x16 improperly read with previous error drawing needs recovery. Process exit status is not acceptance. Later bounded, warning-free conversion results for both default and explicit Global profiles are recorded in p6-ac1024-synthetic-vport-null-roles-2026-11-04.json.
validation.peerReview: Independent read-only review found the initial missing HEADER links and pre-identity attestation; both were corrected and re-reviewed with no additional concrete finding in those changes.

limits: One AC1024 source profile and generated graph transport only. The original generated output failed ODA conversion; the later VPORT-corrected bounded samples are recorded separately. No broad AC1024 interoperability, native CAD, rendering, or general material support claim is justified.

The opt-in cannot validate hidden references inside opaque caller payloads. Its provider must affirm the exact four identities do not conflict, and opaque DWG replay is refused. Callers unable to establish that condition must not opt in.

This work does not correct generic DWG MATERIAL replay, which can omit detached map filename strings when replaying captured opaque body bits. That requires source-profile string-order proof and mutable-state protection before a safe change.
AC1021, AC1027 and AC1032 default material synthesis remains unsupported until independently witnessed and validated.
